local function v_u_238(p190, p191, p192) -- name: calculateSnapTransform
	-- upvalues: (copy) v_u_6, (copy) v_u_172, (copy) v_u_18, (copy) v_u_19
	local v193 = p190.Parent
	if v193 and (v193:IsA("Model") and (v193.Name == "Sail" and v_u_6:HasTag(p191, "RaftBasePart"))) then

			local v196 = v193.PrimaryPart.Position - v193:GetPivot().Position

		end

		end
		v198 = {}
		for _, v201 in ipairs(v198) do
			if v201.name == "Top" or v201.name == "Bottom" then
				continue
			end
			table.insert(v198, v201)
		end
	end
	local v202 = (1 / 0)
	local v203 = nil
	local v204 = nil
	local v205 = nil
	local v206 = nil
	local v207 = (1 / 0)
	for _, v208 in ipairs(v197) do
		for _, v209 in ipairs(v198) do
			local v210 = (v208.position - v209.position).Magnitude
			if p192 and v208.name == p192[1] then
				if v209.name == p192[2] then
					v207 = v210
					v204 = v209
					v203 = v208
				end
			end
			if v210 >= v202 then
				continue
			end
			v206 = v209
			v205 = v208
			v202 = v210
		end
	end
	if v203 and v204 and (v205.name ~= p192[1] or v206.name ~= p192[2]) then
		if v207 > v202 + 1 then
			v204 = v206
			v203 = v205
		end
	else
		v204 = v206
		v203 = v205
	end
	if not (v203 and v204) then
		return nil, nil
	end
	local v211 = { v203.name, v204.name }
	local v212 = p190.CFrame:PointToObjectSpace(v203.position)
	local v213 = -v204.normal
	local v214 = v203.normal
	local v215 = v214:Cross(v213)
	local v216 = v214:Dot(v213)
	local v217 = math.clamp(v216, -1, 1)
	local v218 = math.acos(v217)
	local v219

		v219 = CFrame.fromAxisAngle(v215.Unit, v218)
	elseif v214:Dot(v213) < 0 then
		local v220 = v214.X
		local v221 = v214:Cross(math.abs(v220) < 0.9 and Vector3.new(1, 0, 0) or Vector3.new(0, 1, 0)).Unit
		v219 = CFrame.fromAxisAngle(v221, 3.141592653589793)
	else
		v219 = CFrame.new()
	end
	local v222 = v219 * p190.CFrame.Rotation
	local v223 = v222.LookVector
	local v224 = v222.UpVector
	local v225 = v224.X * 0.3
	local v226 = v224.Y
	local v227 = v224.Z * 0.3
	local v228 = Vector3.new(v225, v226, v227).Unit
	local v229 = v223.X
	local v230 = v223.Y * 0.3
	local v231 = v223.Z
	local v232 = Vector3.new(v229, v230, v231).Unit
	local v233 = v232:Cross(v228).Unit

	function v_u_73.calculate(p76) -- name: calculate
		-- upvalues: (copy) v_u_11, (copy) v_u_18, (copy) v_u_19, (ref) v_u_75, (ref) v_u_74, (copy) v_u_37, (copy) v_u_21, (copy) v_u_20

local function v_u_74(p67) -- name: isLootWithDisabledPickup
	-- upvalues: (copy) v_u_7, (copy) v_u_3
	if not (p67 and p67:IsA("BasePart")) then
		return false
	end
	local v68 = p67:FindFirstAncestorOfClass("Tool")
	if v68 then
		if v68:GetAttribute("LootBoxOpened") then
			return false
		end
		local v69 = v68:FindFirstChild("Handle")
		if v69 then
			local v70 = v69:FindFirstChild("PickupPrompt")
			if v70 and (v70:IsA("ProximityPrompt") and not v70.Enabled) then
				return true
			end
		end
	end
	local v71 = p67.Parent
	while v71 and v71 ~= v_u_7 do
		if v71:IsA("Model") and v_u_3:HasTag(v71, "ArmorPiece") then
			if v71:GetAttribute("LootBoxOpened") then
				return false
			end
			local v72 = v71.PrimaryPart or v71:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("BasePart")
			if v72 then
				local v73 = v72:FindFirstChild("EquipPrompt")
				if v73 and (v73:IsA("ProximityPrompt") and not v73.Enabled) then
					return true
				end
			end
			return false
		end
		v71 = v71.Parent
	end
	return false
end
local function v_u_92(p75, p76) -- name: getClosestPointOnPart
	local v77 = p75.CFrame:PointToObjectSpace(p76)
	local v78 = p75.Size / 2
	local v79 = v77.X
	local v80 = -v78.X
	local v81 = v78.X
	local v82 = math.clamp(v79, v80, v81)
	local v83 = v77.Y
	local v84 = -v78.Y
	local v85 = v78.Y
	local v86 = math.clamp(v83, v84, v85)
	local v87 = v77.Z
	local v88 = -v78.Z
	local v89 = v78.Z
	local v90 = math.clamp(v87, v88, v89)
	local v91 = Vector3.new(v82, v86, v90)
	return p75.CFrame:PointToWorldSpace(v91)
end
local function v_u_111(p93, p94) -- name: getClosestPointOnModel
	local v95, v96 = p93:GetBoundingBox()
	local v97 = v95:PointToObjectSpace(p94)
	local v98 = v96 / 2
	local v99 = v97.X
	local v100 = -v98.X
	local v101 = v98.X
	local v102 = math.clamp(v99, v100, v101)
	local v103 = v97.Y
	local v104 = -v98.Y
	local v105 = v98.Y
	local v106 = math.clamp(v103, v104, v105)
	local v107 = v97.Z
	local v108 = -v98.Z
	local v109 = v98.Z
	local v110 = math.clamp(v107, v108, v109)
	return v95:PointToWorldSpace((Vector3.new(v102, v106, v110)))
end

	-- upvalues: (ref) v_u_43, (copy) v_u_7

local v_u_80 = 0
function move(p81) -- name: move
	-- upvalues: (ref) v_u_80, (ref) v_u_45, (ref) v_u_8, (copy) v_u_7, (copy) v_u_3, (copy) v_u_4, (copy) v_u_5, (copy) v_u_6, (ref) v_u_43, (ref) v_u_44, (ref) v_u_61
	local v82 = 1
	local v83 = 1
	local v84 = p81 - v_u_80
	v_u_80 = p81
	local v85 = false
	if v_u_45 > 0 then
		v_u_45 = v_u_45 - v84
	end
	if v_u_8 == "FreeFall" and v_u_45 <= 0 then
		playAnimation("fall", 0.3, v_u_7)
	else
		if v_u_8 == "Seated" then
			playAnimation("sit", 0.5, v_u_7)
			return
		end
		if v_u_8 == "Running" then
			playAnimation("walk", 0.1, v_u_7)
		elseif v_u_8 == "Dead" or (v_u_8 == "GettingUp" or (v_u_8 == "FallingDown" or (v_u_8 == "Seated" or v_u_8 == "PlatformStanding"))) then
			stopAllAnimations()
			v85 = true
			v83 = 1
			v82 = 0.1
		end
	end
	if v85 then
		local v86 = p81 * v83
		local v87 = v82 * math.sin(v86)
		v_u_3:SetDesiredAngle(v87 + 0)
		v_u_4:SetDesiredAngle(v87 - 0)
		v_u_5:SetDesiredAngle(-v87)
		v_u_6:SetDesiredAngle(-v87)
	end
	local v88 = getTool()
	if v88 and v88:FindFirstChild("Handle") then
		local v89 = getToolAnim(v88)
		if v89 then
			v_u_43 = v89.Value
			v89.Parent = nil
			v_u_44 = p81 + 0.3
		end
		if v_u_44 < p81 then
			v_u_44 = 0
			v_u_43 = "None"
		end
		animateTool()
	else
		stopToolAnimations()
		v_u_43 = "None"
		v_u_61 = nil
		v_u_44 = 0
	end
end
